tasks.name: Compute and embed WCAG matrix
tasks.description: Calculate contrast ratios for useful Acid Dispatch text/background combinations, save raw data, and embed a readable compliance matrix in the brandbook.
acceptance_criteria: WCAG contrast data exists as parseable JSON under company/brand/brandbook-packet/tokens/.
Every useful approved and derived text/background pairing has a calculated ratio and normal/large-text result.

AA thresholds of 4.5:1 normal and 3.0:1 large are documented.
tasks.verification: command review: record matrix cell count, AA-normal count, AA-large count, calculation method, and source/token paths
tasks.notes: Passed the refreshed T009 calculation, embedding, render, visual, and independent formula audit against the final US Letter source. Canonicalized 22 unique approved/derived colors and calculated all 484 ordered foreground/background combinations, including self-pairs and failures, using WCAG 2.x relative luminance. Raw parseable JSON records each ratio, normal-AA result at 4.5:1, large-AA result at 3.0:1, and status: 178 normal-AA passes, 238 large-AA passes, 60 large-only pairs, and 246 all-text failures. Page 10 embeds all 49 anchor combinations plus 8 verified normal-AA recommendations and both thresholds. Independent recalculation found 0 ratio, normal-result, large-result, or status mismatches. The final 2112x1632 preview keeps the matrix, key, recommendations, and thresholds legible with 0 clipping/overflow. Evidence: tokens/wcag-matrix.json and references/t009-audit.json.
